This move was also influenced by the looming IPO of Anthropic, which is also in the AI space, [3]. The market's decline was a sign of caution among investors, [2].
Nasdaq (-1.78% to 23995.13): Nasdaq Falls on Tech Woes. The Nasdaq fell 1.78% to 23995.13 as investors reacted to the decline of AI stocks, including Nvidia, which led the way lower. The decline in tech shares was also influenced by concerns about a reported NSA network outage, which traders are watching closely. The Dow also fell 700 points, pulling the S&P 500 down 2%.
10-Year Yield (-0.2% to 5.06): Yield Drop Sparks Market Watch. The 10-year yield fell 0.2% to 5.06 [10], as investors weighed the state of the U.S. economy and considered the potential impact of future interest rate hikes. [10] CNBC reported that the yield had inched higher, but then retreated as investors reassessed their expectations. [10] The market is watching for any signs of a shift in the Fed's monetary policy, which could influence the yield. [11]
USD/JPY (+0.15% to 159.74): Yen Weakens Ahead of BoJ Hike. The USD/JPY pair rose 0.15% to 159.74 as traders anticipated a potential interest rate hike by the Bank of Japan, which could lead to a stronger US dollar and a weaker yen. [12] FXStreet reported that the yen was weakening towards 160 against the US dollar as the BoJ hike looms. [14] BigGo Finance also noted that rising US long-term yields had boosted the dollar-yen pair. [13]
Crude Oil (-0.47% to 82.87): Crude Oil Prices Fall Amid Supply Concerns. Crude oil prices fell overnight as traders took into account a larger-than-expected inventory build in the US, which reinforced concerns about a global supply surplus. This move was also influenced by the recovery of Middle East exports, which offset some of the concerns about tanker attacks in the region. As a result, traders are now watching the balance of supply and demand closely, with a focus on the impact of these developments on global oil markets.
